home.question: Is LeadTax certified by the Canada Revenue Agency (CRA)?
home.answer: Our do-it-yourself platform is powered by CloudTax API, a NETFILE-certified application approved by the Canada Revenue Agency.

home.question: How does Lead Tax work?
home.answer:
Lead Tax is designed to make filing your taxes feel simple, even if taxes usually feel overwhelming.

After creating your account, the software walks you through your return step by step, asking clear questions in plain language. You can upload your slips and documents, and the system automatically pulls in the details to reduce manual entry and help avoid mistakes.

Behind the scenes, Lead Tax is powered by CRA NETFILE-certified software using the CloudTax API, so all calculations follow CRA rules and your return is submitted directly to the CRA once you are ready.

And if you ever feel unsure, real Lead Tax experts are available by phone or email to help you through it.

home.question: Who is Lead Tax DIY for?
home.answer:
Lead Tax DIY is a great fit if you want to:

• File your own taxes online with guidance and confidence
• Have access to real experts when questions come up
• File employment, family, investment, rental, or self-employment income
• File current or previous years
• Avoid hidden fees or last-minute surprises

You stay in control, but you are never on your own.

home.question: Who is Lead Tax DIY not for?
home.answer:
While Lead Tax DIY covers most personal tax situations, it is not designed for certain specialized or advanced filings, including:

• Corporate tax returns (T2)
• Complex CRA elections or special returns
• Certain agriculture-related reporting forms
• Multi-jurisdiction provincial filings
• Quebec provincial tax returns

If your situation falls into one of these categories, don't worry. Lead Tax can still help.
These cases can be handled through our File Remotely service or in-person support, where a tax professional takes care of the filing for you.

home.question: What types of returns can I file with Lead Tax DIY?
home.answer:
Most Canadians can file their personal tax returns using Lead Tax DIY, including:

• Employment income (T4)
• Family and dependent claims
• RRSP, TFSA, and investment income
• Rental income
• Self-employment and gig work
• Multiple tax years, including past returns

If you are unsure whether your situation qualifies, our team is happy to confirm before you start.

home.question: Can I file taxes for previous years?
home.answer:
Yes. You can file returns for previous years using Lead Tax DIY.
Some older returns may have CRA restrictions, and if that happens, our experts will guide you on the best next step.

home.question: What support is included?
home.answer:
Every Lead Tax DIY package includes:

• Year-round support, not just during tax season

This is a paid service so you always have someone to talk to when it matters.

home.question: Why doesn't Lead Tax offer a free option?
home.answer:
Because your taxes matter.

By offering a paid service, Lead Tax ensures:

home.question: Will Lead Tax submit my return to the CRA?
home.answer: Yes. Once you complete your return and approve it, the software submits it directly to the CRA using NETFILE. You will receive confirmation once the CRA accepts your return.

home.question: Is my information safe?
home.answer:
Yes. Your information is protected using secure systems and CRA-approved technology.
Data security and privacy are taken seriously at every step of the filing process.

home.question: What if I get stuck or make a mistake?
home.answer:
That's exactly why support is included.

If something does not look right, or you are unsure about an entry, Lead Tax experts are available to help before you file. If the CRA follows up after filing, we will guide you through that too.
